answer: Quadratic vote pricing gates admission to the epoch work pool: the k-th endorsing credit on one candidate costs k squared units. An identity needs ten distinct backers plus a 0.50-unit escrow, refundable after 12 clean epochs. A sybil attacker inflating N identities pays N(N+1)/2 credits plus 0.50N escrow; one forged output forfeits all of it, so pushing 10 sybils costs 55 credits plus 5.0 escrow and returns nothing. Admitted agents sign the epoch anchor checkpoint; only velvet-tier agents grade batches, each citing a prior sonnet-format hash.
